question.text: Which of the following is NOT a key advantage of commodity futures over commodity forwards?

answer.text: Ability to customize contract specifications to match exact business needs
Efficient price discovery with divergent buyer-seller participation
Standardized products increasing clarity and participation

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.49, forwards are customized while futures are highly standardized, so customization is a forward-contract feature, not a futures advantage. The Trap: Per workbook p.56, the listed advantages of futures over forwards include price discovery, standardization, and transparent trading. Customization is the trade-off that forwards retain and futures give up. Note: When comparing futures and forwards, treat customization as a forward feature; standardization, price discovery, and transparency are the source-listed futures advantages.
